instruction: The previous directory-swap finding remains unresolved at evaluated SHA 95f214a6f8233c268e71749d17ef896cbbb3be0c: surrounding path-based operations with identity checks still leaves a TOCTOU window. Recovery must use operations anchored to verified directory handles (or a platform helper providing equivalent openat/linkat/renameat/unlinkat semantics), or explicitly narrow the trust model and obtain human approval for the residual external-mutation risk.

findings.summary: Directory identity checks do not close the directory-swap race because each pathname-based open, link, rename, or unlink still occurs after the final check. A concurrent replacement in that interval can redirect the operation outside the repository; detecting the replacement afterward does not undo the external mutation.

evidence_refs.section: evaluator-evidence-boundary.ts: checkpoint followed by pathname-based open/link/rename/unlink operations
